text:
sam: kicking off preflight for the three-zone cutover (US -> EU -> APAC). change window 02:00-10:00 UTC. plan: canary slices 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m holdpoints. Will run capacity smoke at each hold.

deploy-bot: v2.3.1 rollout initiated to canary group (slice-1). track with /deploy status 3129876543. Logs: `deploy started, canary=5%` :rocket:

jess: FYI capacity snapshot before we start: US reserved=120 GPUs, EU reserved=80 GPUs, APAC reserved=40 GPUs. warm pool nodes: US=20, EU=10, APAC=6. burst cushion configured +15% across zones.

leo: running quick qps probe now against canary endpoint. script: ```./tools/traffic-sim --target=slice-1 --qps=1200 --duration=120``` will post results in 5m.

anya: set autoscaler lower bound to keep warm pool during scale spikes. also raising thermal alarm to 85% GPU util across the fleet for this window. if thermal hits, we abort cutover and back out.

ellie: tagging runbooks for oncall: /runbook/rollout-threezone.md pinned to this thread. If we need immediate rollback, follow section "fast-pin-rollback": run `rbctl pin --zone=<zone> --version=v2.2.9` then stop traffic.

deploy-bot: canary progress: slice-1 -> 5% completed. health checks: OK. kv-cache hit rate stable at 92%. latency P95=132ms (US).

leo: probe results: 5% canary, QPS 1200 steady. CPU 68%, GPU util ~58%, token throughput nominal. No errors in 2m smoke.

jess: quick capacity check: headroom after canary at current QPS: US=+18 nodes equivalent, EU=+6, APAC=+3. APAC tight but within cushion. Recommend proceed to 25% canary for US/EU now; hold on APAC until EU warmup finished.

sam: agreed. sequence: bump US/EU to 25% now, APAC wait. can we pin model variant fallback for APAC if P95>200ms?

anya: yes. fallback rule prepared: if latency.p95(zone) > 200ms for 5m OR error_rate > 1% then route APAC to v2.2.9 with `routectl set-fallback apac v2.2.9`. I'll pre-stage the pin script.

deploy-bot: canary update: US/EU -> 25% started. APAC remains at 5%. deploy log id=3129876601.

leo: starting extended smoke for 25% slices. running e2e cue checks and cost telemetry. ETA 8m.

jess: ops note: quota alerts for EU were at 78% memory utilization earlier; ops increased eviction priority on batch jobs so serving keeps headroom. We'll watch for page noise.

ellie: added a temporary circuit-breaker: if any zone sees sustained 90% GPU util for 3m, auto-degrade to snapshot-variant (v2.2.9) and send page to #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: US/EU 25% complete. health checks: US OK, EU slight spike in cold startups (avg cold-start=240ms) but steady. APAC still stable at 5%.

sam: EU cold-starts are a concern. do we want to pause EU rollout and extend warmup? what's the cold-start distribution?

leo: digging— cold starts concentrated on a small subset of instances that missed warm-pool initialization. 85% of EU nodes are fine. Suggest drain and warmup problematic nodes, extend EU holdpoint by 15m.

jess: +1 to pausing EU and extending hold. We should not push APAC until EU is green. Priority: avoid cross-zone cascading demand.

anya: pausing EU now and extending holdpoint. command: `deploy-bot hold --zone=eu --reason='cold-start spike' --duration=15m`

deploy-bot: EU hold applied. APAC remains at 5%. US at 25% and healthy.

leo: warming problematic EU nodes with `infractl warm --zone=eu --node-filter=tag:missed-warmup` ; expecting warmup complete in ~7m.

ellie: rolling monitoring rubric: while EU on hold, we'll run a high-frequency latency check and heatmap every 60s. If any 3-sample rolling p95 > 220ms, escalate.

deploy-bot: warmup probes show EU node count returning to target. warm pool fill 98%.

leo: EU warmup done. rerunning the 25% smoke. starting in 30s.

deploy-bot: EU 25% smoke run OK so far. P95 trending down to 150ms.

jess: capacity reconfirm: after EU resumed, headroom EU=+9 nodes equiv. APAC still tight but cushion remains. We can cautiously ramp APAC to 25% but do a staged 15% intermediate step (5% -> 15% -> 25%) with 5m checks.

sam: let's do 15% for APAC first. If APAC p95 < 180ms for 5m, continue to 25%. fallback rule stands for pin to v2.2.9.

deploy-bot: APAC ramp to 15% in progress.

leo: APAC 15% smoke: QPS steady, GPU util ~72%, P95=170ms, errors 0.12%. Holding for 5m.

anya: thermal alarm watching APAC. currently GPU temp normal.

ellie: reminder — rollback play if combined error spike across zones >1.5% or regional cascading backpressure. we keep the old version hot for fast pin.

deploy-bot: APAC 15% hold complete, metrics stable. proceeding to 25% now.

leo: APAC 25% smoke: P95=185ms, GPU util 78%. slightly higher, but under 200ms threshold. monitoring next 6m.

jess: heads-up: cost telemetry shows token cost delta +12% at 25% due to increased token churn, expected. we have runway under budget but call it out to finance.

sam: final checks— any objections to completing full rollout after 25% holds finish?

anya: none from infra. autoscaler thresholds active. fallback scripts staged.

ellie: oncall ready. runbook ready. I'll keep this thread pinned while finalizing notes for release notes.

deploy-bot: rollout status: canary->25% across US/EU/APAC complete, proceeding to full ramp in slices per schedule. Next: gradual 2x ramp every 10m until 100% unless an abort trigger fires.

sam: thanks team. I'll post a short summary for release notes and close the loop: v2.3.1 cutover complete to 25% across zones; no rollback needed. full ramp begins on schedule. :thumbsup:
